test_video_alignment_model: test the video alignment model on a specified dataset and save evaluation results to a pickle file
run_model_evaluation: run the main evaluation pipeline for a video alignment model with configurable hyperparameters and random seed
evaluate_map_score: evaluate mean average precision on Madonna or EVVE datasets with optional query expansion strategies
compute_localization_errors: compute localization errors for datasets with localization capability excluding VCDB
segment_precision_recall: compute precision-recall curves and AUC for VCDB dataset segmentation evaluation
